item: The city gazetteer builder reports a read cut at its deadline as the deadline on Windows, not as a refused connection
summary: The watchdog closed the response at the deadline and the reader then asked time.monotonic() whether the deadline had passed; on Windows a timer can fire a clock tick early, so the closed socket's OSError read as a dropped connection (exit 2). The watchdog now sets an Event when it cuts and every check honours it. Release line: On Windows, the city gazetteer builder now reports a read cut at its deadline as the deadline, not as a refused connection.
